claude_worker.description: Default worker for Claude Code (Sonnet); strong at frontend, UI, browser acceptance and docs.

codex_worker.description: Default worker for Codex (gpt-6.1-sol); strong at backend logic, algorithms, refactors and long-running test loops.

grok_worker.description: Example worker for Grok (grok-4.7); strong at research.

qoder_worker.description: Free routine worker (Qwen3.8-Flash via qodercli); resolve --class mechanical|routine picks it for routine implementation whose plan is frozen and write scope is explicit.

opencode_worker.description: Free mechanical worker (glm-5.3-flash-free via opencode); resolve --class mechanical picks it for rule-bound edits, test runs, lint fixes and read-only sweeps. Its TUI uses the variant remembered in ~/.local/state/opencode/model.json, which must match effort.
